pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/21521

The "is closed" message can happen after `server.StopAsync` returns. Even if we unblock the app after seeing "Some connections failed to close gracefully" (which is the main point of this test), the 1 second abort timeout in Kestrel can still make this test flaky. In the future we can consider having the abort timeout internal and setting it to something greater than 1 second and then we can unblock the app func sooner.

review_comments: The idea is that once we do that and then increase the abort timeout, we won't need to have `new DiagnosticMemoryPoolFactory(allowLateReturn: true);` in this test. Controlling the abort timeout from the test is kind of a big change, but unblocking the request before StopAsync completes is easy enough.
